notes.title: Big Update 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]



[h3]Greetings!
We are happy to announce the release of the third and final rework update for the game![/h3]

We have analyzed your feedback and made significant changes to the game.
Now players have much more freedom and control. Many restrictions have been removed.
Most changes concern combat rules. Now they are clearer and more familiar.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/aadec21b2854d2454150ae9ac03ccd6691bdcf9b.gif[/img]



[h3]Combat rules changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players are no longer forcibly pulled into a location when a battle starts.
Now you decide whether to control the organisms yourself or let them fight automatically without your direct control.

[*] The restriction of having only one squad in battle has been removed.
Now you can send as many organisms into battle as you want.

[*] You no longer need to finish the battle to leave the location.
Now during battle, you can go to the global map or constructor. The battle will continue automatically without your control.
[/list]



[h3]Campaign missions balanced. To see these changes, restart the current mission or start another:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A significant number of enemies on locations removed for faster game progression.
[*] Resource amounts on locations balanced.
[*] Most locations now have neutral temperature.
[*] Almost all enemy walls in the campaign have been removed, but they can build them themselves.
[/list]



[h3]Other game improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Organisms in spore state can now exist for 5 minutes. If not moved to a safe place in time, they will be destroyed.
[*] Workers on the global map are now animated, making the global map feel more alive.
[*] Cursor hotspot adjusted for more precise control.
[*] The "Complete Mission" button has been moved to the top to avoid interfering with the rest of the interface.
[*] The help button now flashes only 3 times and then turns off automatically.
[*] Font size increased in some interface elements.
[*] "Relax mode" is now disabled by default. You can enable it at any time for an easier difficulty level.
[/list]



[hr][/hr] 
[i]Thank you very much to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And special thanks to those supporting the game!
We sincerely strive to bring you joy! [/i]

[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 1.1.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]



[b]Hello everyone!
We’ve just released the second update from our major game overhaul package.[/b]


In this update, we’ve introduced a new feature: quick organism creation.
We noticed that the current organism creation system was too complex and unnecessarily deep for many players.
To address this, we’ve made the process simpler and faster—since in many cases, players just need a basic organism without going through all the adaptation stages.


The Organism Constructor now includes a new function called “Spawn Organism.”
After designing your organism, you can click this button to immediately begin the spawning process in the incubator. Once it’s complete, the organism will automatically leave the nest.


Of course, the original creation method is still available for those times when you want to leave an organism in the nest to adapt to cold or heat.



[hr][/hr] 
[i]A huge thank you to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And a special thanks to those who support the game!
We are doing our best to bring you joy! [/i]

[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 1.1.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]



[b]Hello everyone!
We have released the first update from a large game overhaul package.[/b]


[hr][/hr] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/59b0a616776875f9fac1795afee4726282f7ef65.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr] 

In this update, we have given you the ability to choose exactly which part you want to build.
We have added an additional window for selecting parts when constructing a part cocoon.
It displays all the prototypes you have discovered in the game, and new ones will be added as you unlock them.


Previously, when building a part cocoon, a random part was assigned, making this mechanic almost meaningless. Since players obtained many parts from defeated opponents— which was the main way of acquiring them—this mechanic was originally designed to encourage players to build different types of organisms instead of using the same parts repeatedly.
However, after conducting research on this matter, we found that such a situation was unlikely because players receive enough parts from enemies.


Now you can choose which part to build and which one you like best. This provides greater freedom and possibilities in the game and enhances the creative aspect of gameplay.


In the next update, we plan to improve the organism construction system. We will add a quick automatic organism creation feature so that all organism-building actions happen automatically. 
The option to manually create organisms will remain available.



[hr][/hr] 

[i]A huge thank you to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And a special thanks to those who support the game!
We are doing our best to bring you joy! [/i]

[b]Enjoy the game![/b]


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Time acceleration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Due to players' requests, we've added the ability to speed up the game.
Acceleration buttons are placed on the interface. You can also use the hotkey Tab.

At the beginning of the battle, time is set to normal. If desired, you can disable this function in the options.
Keep in mind that all processes in the game occur in real-time. AI also gathers resources, creates organisms in the incubator, and builds buildings.

Now you can simply speed up the sluggish moments :)





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/e1ff0f2035bab3458d6f8d47f9a201962a56954c.png[/img]

notes.title: New content
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We have added a new building - "Biomass Receiver".
In Biomass Receiver, workers gather biomatter particles. Now workers don't need to constantly travel back to the colony.
This is especially important on large maps. It will speed up biomatter collection and minimize the chance of a worker getting stuck at an enemy wall or having to navigate through the enemy.

Also, enemy workers will less frequently annoy you by entering your locations.
We have also slightly increased the speed of movement for all organisms on the global map.
Now organisms will move a little faster.

The achievement "Great Researcher" has been removed.

Organism positions on the location are now saved after transitioning to the incubator.

notes.title: All done.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
We have made a big update for you. The game balance has been reworked.
Now the game has become more relaxed and no longer requires meticulous strategy in combat. But if you prefer the original gameplay process, you can disable "Relax game mode" in the game options.
[b]All known bugs have also been fixed.[/b]

[h3]A more detailed list of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game difficulty significantly reduced.

[*] Research time halved.

[*] Organism recovery time doubled.

[*] The amount of biomatter in biomatter sources increased by more than 2 times.

[*] Game balance reworked. If you want to return to the original balance, disable "Relax game mode" in the game options.

[*] AI in the campaign can now only build one extractor.

[*] The "Back" button on the main panel is now displayed when entering the incubator.

[*] Fixed a bug causing some menu buttons to disappear.

[*] Added: Additional information messages in quest mission 6.

[*] Added: Additional information messages explaining the rules of the game.

[*] Fixed: Worker did not pick up organism spore if it was among biomatter particles.

[*] Fixed minor technical errors.

[*] All known bugs fixed.
[/list]
[h3]What we'll do next:[/h3]
We plan to create a new building. Workers will be able to deposit biomatter into it, so they won't have to go to the nest every time.
We are already working on DLC with a map generator for endless gameplay.

notes.title: Development News. Coming soon! :)
notes.content:
[h2]Good news: Microcosmum 2 is almost ready![/h2]
We have completed the storyline campaign and all functionalities.
Currently, the game is undergoing internal testing. We are fixing minor issues and adjusting the balance.


[h2]Mission Generator.[/h2]
We are also busy developing the mission generator. This is a big and complex task.
I believe a mission generator is necessary in the game so that Microcosmum 2 not only has a storyline campaign but also non-storyline missions.
We plan to add new content directly to the mission generator in the future to avoid disrupting the balance of the main campaign.


[h2]Release Look of Microcosmum 2.[/h2]
I have created a new design for the game page. Now you can see the release version of Microcosmum 2.
Check out the release trailer for Microcosmum 2:

[previewyoutube=7zSJkrsIbq0;full]https://youtu.be/7zSJkrsIbq0?feature=shared[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Translation into multiple languages.[/h2]
Microcosmum 2 has also been translated into 17 languages!
Microcosmum 2 is different from typical strategies. You'll have to figure it out, but don't worry—the learning process is woven into the storyline campaign, and understanding the gameplay won't be difficult. On the contrary, learning will become an atmospheric journey.
For this reason, Microcosmum 2 has been translated into the following languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Danish
[*] Spanish - Latin America
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] Dutch
[*] Polish
[*] Turkish
[*] Czech
[*] Japanese
[/list]
[h3]Thanks to everyone who loves and is waiting for Microcosmum 2! :)
Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist. It's important for the game)[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486140/Microcosmum_2/

notes.title: Animation improvements. Development news.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KWucHhqS1uA;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]In Microcosmum 2 we have combined animations with realistic physics. The result is amazing.
In the example, the old version of the getter and the new one using animation and physics.[/b]



[h3]On the current development of the game:[/h3]
We have completed all the functionality. Brought the quality of the game almost to the final.
Now we are doing a story campaign. About 10% done. I think it will take another three to five months.

I decided to move away from the concept of the first part, where there were just levels without any background and explanation of what is happening.
Microcosmum 2 has a general storyline, quests and dialogue in each level.
Yes, in the Microcosmum now there is someone to talk to)
This brings a lot of variety to the game and breathes life into Microcosmum.



[h3]Thanks to everyone who loves Microcosmum and who is waiting for the second game![/h3]
Don't forget to add Microcosmum 2 to your wishlist. This affects the future of the project.
